svg.aria-label: Left: the squares C, W, D, S of a missing west wing with W on the west side and S on the south side of C, at v = 0.3, s = 0, d = 0.75, in the smallest disk that allows these separations (radius 1.722, pink; the circle of radius R0 is dashed); the separating lines of the stress with the weights 2, 4, 3, 3 and the forces on the four squares (orange arrows). Right: the domain of (s, d), shaded by the minimum over v of the profile, with the lower bounds of Table D.6 at its corners
